sloka: तीरम् तु समनुप्राप्य नावम् हित्वा नर ऋषभः ।प्रातिष्ठत सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च परम् तपः ॥२-५२-९३॥
transliteration: tīram tu samanuprāpya nāvam hitvā nara ṛṣabhaḥ ।prātiṣṭhata saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca param tapaḥ ॥2-52-93॥

translations.english: Rama, the best of men and tormentor of enemies, after reaching the other side of the river, left the boat and proceeded with Sita and his brother.
